name: Zoooom!
description: Allows you to zoom while paused!

basic-title.name: Basic Settings
basic-title.description: The most common settings for zooming.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Prevent zooming while an attempt is still alive. Disable this to allow zooming mid attempt.

safe-mode-bypass.name: Allow Safe Mode Bypass
safe-mode-bypass.description: Hold the bypass key while starting zoom to unlock zoom for the rest of the current attempt. Using zoom mid attempt may invalidate the attempt.
safe-mode-bypass.enable-if-description: Only available while Safe Mode is enabled.

zoom-sensitivity.name: Zoom Sensitivity
zoom-sensitivity.description: How quickly zoom responds. Higher values make scroll, keybind, and pinch zoom faster.

hide-practice-buttons.name: Hide Practice Buttons
hide-practice-buttons.description: Hide the practice checkpoint buttons while zooming.

advanced-title.name: Advanced Settings
advanced-title.description: Advanced options for fine-tuning the zooming experience.

show-back-button.name: Show Back Button
show-back-button.description: Show the back button inside the zoom menu.

show-zoom-menu-button.name: Show Zoom Menu Button
show-zoom-menu-button.description: Show the zoom button in the pause menu on desktop.

auto-hide-menu.name: Auto Hide Menu
auto-hide-menu.description: Automatically hides the menu when you zoom in.

auto-show-menu.name: Auto Show Menu
auto-show-menu.description: Automatically shows the menu when you zoom back out.

alt-disables-zoom.name: Alt Disables Zoom
alt-disables-zoom.description: Disables zooming while Alt is held.

controls-title.name: Controls
controls-title.description: Settings for the controls and keybinds.

safe-mode-bypass-key.name: Safe Mode Bypass Key
safe-mode-bypass-key.description: Hold this key while starting zoom to bypass Safe Mode for the current attempt.
safe-mode-bypass-key.enable-if-description: Only available while Safe Mode bypass is enabled.

toggle-menu.name: Toggle Zoom UI
toggle-menu.description: Open or close the zoom controls while paused. Closing the controls keeps your current zoom.

zoom-in.name: Zoom In
zoom-in.description: Press to zoom in while paused.

zoom-out.name: Zoom Out
zoom-out.description: Press to zoom out while paused.

pan.name: Pan
pan.description: Hold to pan the zoomed view with your mouse while paused.

pan-button.name: Pan Button
pan-button.description: Choose which mouse button pans the zoomed view on PC.

minimap-title.name: Minimap
minimap-title.description: Settings for the minimap shown while zooming.

enable-minimap.name: Enable Minimap
enable-minimap.description: Show a minimap while using zoom.

minimap-position.name: Minimap Position
minimap-position.description: Choose which corner displays the minimap.
minimap-position.enable-if-description: Only available while the minimap is enabled.

minimap-scale.name: Minimap Scale
minimap-scale.description: Adjust the size of the minimap. 1.0 now matches the old 0.5x size, while 2.0 matches the old 1.0x size.
minimap-scale.enable-if-description: Only available while the minimap is enabled.

minimap-outer-fill-color.name: Outer Fill Color
minimap-outer-fill-color.description: The color and transparency used for the minimap background.
minimap-outer-fill-color.enable-if-description: Only available while the minimap is enabled.

minimap-outer-outline-color.name: Outer Outline Color
minimap-outer-outline-color.description: The color and transparency used for the minimap outline.
minimap-outer-outline-color.enable-if-description: Only available while the minimap is enabled.

minimap-inner-fill-color.name: Inner Fill Color
minimap-inner-fill-color.description: The color and transparency used for the viewport fill.
minimap-inner-fill-color.enable-if-description: Only available while the minimap is enabled.

minimap-inner-outline-color.name: Inner Outline Color
minimap-inner-outline-color.description: The color and transparency used for the viewport outline.
minimap-inner-outline-color.enable-if-description: Only available while the minimap is enabled.
